nodes.name: Hydrothermal MoSe2 lamination and Co-MOF to CoSe2 conversion
nodes.procedure: 2D nanoflakes MoSe2 were laminated over CC/MOF via a hydrothermal method (optimized deposition time of 4h for shell-MoSe2 layer) to form the fine core-shell nanostructure. During the hydrothermal process of MoSe2, the Co-MOF is converted into the CoSe2.

nodes.characterization_summary: FE-SEM shows well-designed core-shell nanostructure with interconnected conductive pathways where MoSe₂ nanoflakes completely cover MOF-CoSe₂ nanowalls.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The surface microstructures of the as-prepared to CC/MOF, CC/ MoSe2, and CC/MOF-CoSe2@MoSe2 were characterized via field emission scanning electron microscopy (FE-SEM), as illustrated in Fig. 2 (a-f).

properties.description: Low magnification view showing porous, aggregated particles with rough morphology
High magnification inset showing nanofiber-like or mesoporous network structure

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM reveals core-shell structure with MoSe₂ nanoflakes (15-22 nm diameter, hundreds nm length) covering nanowalls; lattice fringes show 0.665 nm (002) MoSe₂, 0.290/0.258/0.247 nm CoSe₂, 0.465/0.360 nm CoMoO₄.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 2 (g, h) presents FE-TEM images of the CC/MOF-CoSe₂@MoSe₂ core-shell structure at multiple magnifications... CC/MOF-CoSe₂@MoSe₂ core-shell nanostructure had lattice fringes of 0.665 nm consistent with the d-spacing of (002) crystal plane of hexagonal MoSe₂.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM confirms lattice fringes of 0.665 nm for (002) MoSe₂, 0.290 nm (110), 0.258 nm (111), 0.247 nm (012) CoSe₂, and 0.465 nm (100), 0.360 nm (110) CoMoO₄.
nodes.evidence_snippet: From the high resolution (HR)-TEM image shown in Fig. 2 (i), each flake had a diameter of 15 - 22 nm... Whereas interplanar distances of 0.290, 0.258, and 0.247 nm correspond to crystal planes (110), (111), and (012) of core-CoSe₂.

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED pattern confirms polycrystalline nature of the core-shell nanostructure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 2 (m) illustrate the selected area electron diffraction (SAED) pattern verified in the polycrystalline kind of the core-shell nanostructure.

nodes.characterization_summary: STEM elemental mapping shows uniform Mo/Se distribution in nanowalls with less Co/O.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 2 (l) signify uniformly distributed Mo and Se in the CC/MOF-CoSe₂ nanowalls where much less Co and O are present.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD confirms hexagonal MoSe₂ (002,100,103,105,110), orthorhombic CoSe₂ (012,121,211), monoclinic CoMoO₄ (010,022,130), and CoO₃Se (110) phases in CC/MOF-CoSe₂@MoSe₂.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The major XRD peaks observed in CC/MoSe₂ and CC/MOF-CoSe₂@MoSe₂ at 13.62°, 31.53°, 37.78°, 47.42° and 55.95° are consistent with the (002), (100), (103), (105), and (110) reflection planes in hexagonal MoSe₂... additional peaks appearing in the pattern for the CC/MOF-CoSe₂@MoSe₂ core-shell nanostructure at 36.67°, 47.79°, and 57.27° are attributed to the (012), (121), and (211) reflection plans of CoSe₂.

nodes.characterization_summary: Raman shows A₁g (239.25 cm⁻¹), E₂g¹ (289.94 cm⁻¹) for MoSe₂; A_g (188 cm⁻¹) Se-Se stretching and 355 cm⁻¹ Co-O-Mo for CC/MOF-CoSe₂@MoSe₂ confirming core-shell interface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As seen in Fig. 3(b), for MoSe₂ as well as for the CC/MOF-CoSe2@MoSe2 core-shell structure, the two resonance peaks centered at 239.25 and 289.94 cm⁻¹ were indexed to the out-of-plane A₁g and in-plane E₂g¹ modes of MoSe₂... For the CC/MOF-CoSe2@MoSe2 core-shell nanostructure, a sharp peak (A_g) appeared at 188 cm⁻¹ due to the Se-Se stretching mode of CoSe₂.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS confirms Co³⁺/Co²⁺ states (Co 2p₃/₂ at 780.60/782.96 eV), 1T/2H Mo⁴⁺ MoSe₂ (Mo 3d peaks at 228.25-232.54 eV), Mo⁶⁺ (235.44 eV), and Se 3d shift to 53.86/54.97 eV for 2H phase in CC/MOF-CoSe₂@MoSe₂.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Co 2p core-level spectra shown in Fig. 3(d) illustrate that peaks for Co 2p₃/₂ were situated at 780.60 and Co 2p₁/₂ at 796.62 eV... In the Mo 3d core-level spectrum in Fig. 3(e), the existence of two strong peaks at 231.34 and 228.25 eV... In the Se 3d core-level spectrum for MoSe₂ (Fig. 3(f)), two distinct peaks... had shifted to higher binding energies of 53.86 and 54.97 eV, respectively, to the 2H MoSe₂.

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-MS shows Co:Mo:Se composition of 14890:257000:466300 ppm (1.49:25.70:46.63 wt%).
nodes.evidence_snippet: ICP-MS measurement indicates that the ion concentrations for Co, Mo, and Se are 14890, 257000, and 466300 ppm, respectively, and the weight ratio of Co:Mo:Se is 1.49:25.70:46.63 wt%.

nodes.characterization_summary: EIS for OER shows smallest R_ct = 25.82 Ω for CC/MOF-CoSe₂@MoSe₂ vs 4.38 Ω (CC/MOF) and 7.69 Ω (CC/MoSe₂).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The R_ct values obtained by fitting the equivalent circuit are 4.38, 7.69, and 25.82 Ω for CC/MOF, CC/MoSe₂, and CC/MOF-CoSe₂@MoSe₂, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: CV determines double-layer capacitance C_dl of 55 μF cm⁻² for CC/MOF-CoSe₂@MoSe₂ (vs 20 and 0.8 μF cm⁻² for CC/MoSe₂ and CC/MOF).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The CC/MOF-CoSe₂@MoSe₂ electrocatalyst attained a C_dl value of 55 μF cm⁻² that proved to be much greater than the CC/MoSe₂ and CC/MOF electrocatalyst (20 and 0.8 μF cm⁻², respectively).
